std_convention: population std ddof=0 across the 5 seeds; a gap smaller than the larger of the two stds is NOT a finding (std rule)

metric.expected_shortfall_def: E[depth | certified miss] = mean(0.94 - Y) over certified true violations (depth in pu)
metric.secondary: full miss-depth distribution with bootstrap CIs, pooled over the 5 splits
metric.max_depth_role: FOOTNOTE only (one order statistic over a handful of events); never a headline

coverage.matched_empirical_def: for each arm/model, pick the coverage TARGET on the sweep grid whose measured empirical coverage on test equals arm A's empirical coverage at target 0.90 (nearest grid point; report the achieved empirical coverage so the match is auditable)

headroom_def.source: each base's N-0 solve (res_gen.q_mvar); requires re-solving the 1500 N-0 bases
headroom_def.q_headroom_up: max_q_mvar - q_mvar   (VAR the gen can still SUPPLY; binds under-voltage)
headroom_def.q_headroom_down: q_mvar - min_q_mvar (VAR the gen can still ABSORB)

features.arm_B: baseline + SCALARS: min q_headroom_up among gens within 1/2/3 graph-hops of EITHER terminal bus of the outaged element; total system q_headroom_up; (same three-hop + total for q_headroom_down). Scalars because ridge cannot represent a min over a set.
features.arm_C: arm_B + the raw per-generator q_headroom_up and q_headroom_down vectors (53*2 cols)
features.report: per model (ridge, histgb), per arm (A, B, C)

diagnostic.qbind_label: a contingency is Q-BIND if, post-outage, any in-service gen has q_mvar >= max_q_mvar - tol OR q_mvar <= min_q_mvar + tol
diagnostic.qbind_scope: labeled ONCE over the full N-1 dataset (seed-independent) by re-solving each contingency with res_gen; reused across arms/seeds. This is the heavy compute: ~278,955 AC solves.
diagnostic.separation: AUC of the arm-B min-headroom scalar vs the Q-bind label
diagnostic.importance: permutation importance of the headroom features RESTRICTED to Q-bind rows
diagnostic.purpose: distinguish 'genuinely unpredictable' (feature has signal but tail unmoved) from 'feature carries no signal'

focus_case.report: each arm's prediction for this row

do_not_assume: the tail may NOT collapse; an unchanged tail WITH confirmed feature signal is a publishable result and must be reported as such
